tools_helpful.evidence: Produced MIGRATION-MAPPING.md/MIGRATION-DEFERRED.md, rewrote using:/xmlns: namespaces, and pre-seeded triage labels so the agent transformed MainPage in place rather than re-authoring it.

tools_helpful.tool: Defensive-UI guidance (SKILL.md 'Defensive UI for init-heavy and device-dependent pages')
tools_helpful.evidence: Agent wrapped camera init in try/catch and added a visible StatusText fallback ('This sample could not initialize on this machine. / No camera device found.') instead of returning silently, which kept the page from crashing on a camera-less box.

tool_limitations.limitation: Validates process-alive and text/residue fidelity but has no contrast/visibility check, so a page that renders content white-on-white passes every gate while being visually blank.
tool_limitations.suggested_tweak: Cannot reliably regex 'Foreground=White' (legitimate over dark containers) -> handled with a sharpened prose rule instead of a noisy validator gate.

special_apis.special_handling: Listed unsupported on WinUI 3 Desktop; here migrated to an Image surface, acceptable for the camera-less parity case (preview blank in both UWP and WinUI).

dev_agent_struggles.where: MainPage.xaml fallback StatusText + disabled command button glyphs
dev_agent_struggles.symptom: Migrated page renders effectively blank: the 'No camera device found' fallback and the three disabled buttons are invisible, where the UWP golden showed three visible grey buttons.
dev_agent_struggles.turns_or_retries: Not a loop; a silent visual defect carried straight from the UWP source without any agent realising it.
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: UWP camera sample uses Foreground="White" (and white icon Fill/BorderBrush + TranslucentBlackBrush) designed to sit over a live camera preview. WinUI 3's default theme follows the system (Light), so ApplicationPageBackgroundThemeBrush resolves to white; the camera surface is blank/absent, so white foreground content renders white-on-white and is invisible.
dev_agent_struggles.how_resolved: Not resolved by the agent; scorer downgraded the only feature from pass to partial (score 50) for a blank-vs-populated frame.
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: SKILL.md defensive-fallback rule must require the fallback to be CONTRAST-visible against the default Light page background (theme-aware foreground, not hardcoded white), and MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md must flag hardcoded literal Foreground/Fill='White' carried from media/camera-overlay pages as invisible on WinUI 3's default Light theme.

env_issues.issue: No camera hardware in the validation environment.
env_issues.workaround: Both UWP and WinUI leave all controls disabled; this is faithful, not a regression. Only the white-on-white invisibility was a defect.
